potential_risks: The customer page errored, so some audience or proof points may be missing.
The crawl contains repeated pricing tables and footer sections, which may overemphasize certain features.
A few features are marked 'coming soon' in pricing and should not be treated as fully available across all plans.
Some demo-like support widget content appears in the crawl and should not be mistaken for separate product pages.
profile_quality.notes: The crawl provides strong core marketing and pricing evidence across homepage and pricing page, enough for a high-confidence profile. Most uncertainty is around legal entity details and any information that would have come from the broken customers page.
